verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a documented in-product audits action titled 'Selecting an Audit Partner', and its docs describe working with your auditor in-platform. This suggests founders can choose an auditor through the vendor, but the pack contains only the page title, with no detail on the network, vetting or booking. missing for 10: evidence of a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm, booking flow details, published audit timeline expectations, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline

citations.quote: Selecting an Audit Partner | Sprinto Docs
work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform
